settings.voiceStyle: ผจญภัย สดใส กระชับ
settings.customCharacterStyle: Faithful recognizable Minecraft block character design
settings.visualStyle: Bright colorful Minecraft exploration with recognizable Steve, lush cave vegetation, glow berries, axolotl pools and sparkling diamond ore. Adventurous but never scary or dark.
settings.customProjectStructure: Silent vertical Minecraft fan adventure, 80 seconds, 10 scenes x 8 seconds. No dialogue and no narration. Music, cave ambience and environmental SFX only. One main action and one camera movement per scene.
settings.customVisualStyle: Colorful Minecraft lush cave with green vines, glow berries, clear pools and friendly axolotl.

movie.mainStoryPrompt: Silent Minecraft adventure. Steve notices an azalea tree and discovers a lush cave below. He explores through glow berries and pools where a pink axolotl swims. Across a clear underground pool he sees diamond ore. Steve builds a small path using moss blocks, mines one diamond, then follows a waterfall passage back toward daylight. At the surface he releases the axolotl from a water bucket into a small pond near his base. No dialogue, no narration, no horror.
movie.storySummary: Steve พบต้น azalea และตามลงไปเจอ Lush Cave ที่สวยงาม เขาพบ axolotl และเห็น diamond ore อยู่อีกฝั่งของสระ จึงสร้างทางข้าม เก็บเพชร แล้วหาทางออกตามน้ำตกกลับสู่พื้นดิน ก่อนปล่อย axolotl ลงในบ่อน้ำใกล้บ้าน
movie.storyTitle: Minecraft Adventures EP05 — เพชรใต้ถ้ำเขียว

scenes.title: The Azalea Tree
scenes.description: Steve notices an azalea tree on the surface.
scenes.location: ทุ่งเหนือถ้ำเขียว (Surface Meadow)
scenes.actionDescription: Steve หยุดดูต้น azalea ที่ขึ้นโดดเด่นกลางทุ่ง
scenes.imageDescription: Recognizable Minecraft Steve in a sunny meadow looking at a flowering azalea tree, grass blocks and distant hills, bright friendly colors.
scenes.videoPrompt: Slow push-in from Steve toward the azalea tree. Audio: meadow ambience, soft discovery music. No speech.

scenes.title: Roots Below
scenes.description: Steve digs a safe staircase beside the rooted dirt.
scenes.location: ทางลงถ้ำเขียว (Lush Cave Entrance)
scenes.actionDescription: Steve ขุดบล็อกดินเป็นขั้นบันไดลงข้าง rooted dirt
scenes.imageDescription: Minecraft Steve digging a staircase down through dirt and rooted dirt under the azalea, warm daylight above.
scenes.videoPrompt: Side tracking shot descending with Steve as he removes a few dirt blocks. Audio: digging sounds, gentle adventure rhythm. No speech.

scenes.title: Lush Cave Reveal
scenes.description: Steve reaches a bright lush cave full of vines and glow berries.
scenes.actionDescription: Steve ก้าวออกจากอุโมงค์สู่ถ้ำเขียวกว้างที่เต็มไปด้วย glow berries และ moss
scenes.imageDescription: Beautiful recognizable Minecraft lush cave, Steve at entrance, moss blocks, azalea roots, glow berries, vines and clear water pools, bright magical-but-game-authentic atmosphere.
scenes.videoPrompt: Slow crane upward to reveal the full lush cave around Steve. Audio: water drips, cave ambience, uplifting discovery music. No speech.

scenes.title: Friendly Axolotl
scenes.description: A pink axolotl swims through the nearby pool.
scenes.actionDescription: Steve คุกเข่าริมสระและมอง axolotl สีชมพูว่ายผ่าน
scenes.imageDescription: Minecraft Steve kneeling beside a lush cave pool while a recognizable pink Minecraft axolotl swims through clear water, glow berries overhead.
scenes.videoPrompt: Low gentle pan following the axolotl through the pool to Steve. Audio: water bubbles, soft playful music. No speech.

scenes.title: Diamond Across the Water
scenes.description: Steve spots diamond ore across the pool.
scenes.actionDescription: Steve เงยหน้าจากสระและเห็น diamond ore บนผนังอีกฝั่ง
scenes.imageDescription: Steve on one side of a clear Minecraft lush cave pool, sparkling diamond ore visible in deepslate on the opposite wall, vines and moss around.
scenes.videoPrompt: Over-the-shoulder slow push toward the diamond ore across the pool. Audio: bright discovery chime, water ambience. No speech.

scenes.title: Moss Block Path
scenes.description: Steve places moss blocks across the shallow edge of the pool.
scenes.actionDescription: Steve วาง moss block เป็นทางสั้น ๆ ข้ามขอบสระไปยังผนังเพชร
scenes.imageDescription: Minecraft Steve placing green moss blocks as stepping stones along a lush cave pool, pink axolotl visible nearby, diamond ore ahead.
scenes.videoPrompt: Side tracking shot with several moss block placements. Audio: block placement clicks, water bubbles, light rhythm. No speech.

scenes.title: One Diamond
scenes.description: Steve mines one diamond ore block.
scenes.actionDescription: Steve ใช้ iron pickaxe ขุด diamond ore หนึ่งก้อน
scenes.imageDescription: Recognizable Minecraft Steve mining one diamond ore block in a bright lush cave, moss and glow berries around, no danger.
scenes.videoPrompt: Medium side shot. Steve swings the pickaxe until one diamond ore breaks and the diamond item appears. Audio: mining hit, item pickup, happy music accent. No speech.

scenes.title: Waterfall Exit
scenes.description: Steve notices daylight filtering through a waterfall passage.
scenes.location: ทางน้ำตก (Waterfall Passage)
scenes.actionDescription: Steve หันไปเห็นแสงอาทิตย์ลอดผ่านทางน้ำตกที่ลาดขึ้น
scenes.imageDescription: Minecraft lush cave waterfall passage with daylight glowing at the top, Steve standing below holding one diamond, bright water and vines.
scenes.videoPrompt: Slow tilt upward from Steve to the daylight above the waterfall. Audio: rushing water, hopeful music. No speech.

scenes.title: Back to the Surface
scenes.description: Steve climbs beside the waterfall and reaches daylight.
scenes.location: ทางน้ำตก (Waterfall Passage)
scenes.actionDescription: Steve ปีนบล็อกข้างน้ำตกขึ้นสู่ทุ่งด้านบน
scenes.imageDescription: Steve emerging from a Minecraft waterfall opening into a sunny meadow, lush cave glow fading behind him.
scenes.videoPrompt: Upward tracking shot following Steve as he climbs into sunlight. Audio: water, birds returning, uplifting music. No speech.

scenes.title: A New Pond Friend
scenes.description: Steve releases the axolotl into a small pond near his house.
scenes.location: บ่อน้ำข้างบ้าน (Home Pond)
scenes.actionDescription: Steve เท water bucket ลงบ่อน้ำเล็กและปล่อย axolotl สีชมพูว่ายออกมา
scenes.imageDescription: Cozy Minecraft base at sunset, Steve beside a small clear pond releasing a pink axolotl from a water bucket, oak house and flowers nearby.
scenes.videoPrompt: Gentle push-in on the axolotl swimming into the pond, then pull back to Steve and the house. Audio: water splash, soft happy music ending. No speech.
